privacy.intro: Situs is self-hosted property-management software. This policy describes what the instance you are using collects, why, how long it keeps it, and what you can require of it under the General Data Protection Regulation. The operator of this instance is the data controller.
privacy.collectAccountBody: Name, email address, and either a hashed password or the identifier returned by your Google sign-in.
privacy.collectPropertyBody: Addresses, lease terms, rent amounts, tenant contact details, tax identification numbers, and documents you upload.
privacy.collectBankBody: Where you connect a bank: the account name and IBAN, and for each movement its date, amount, counterparty name, counterparty IBAN, and the free-text reference your bank supplies.
privacy.use1: To run the service: recording properties, leases, tenants and rent.
privacy.use2: To reconcile rent against bank movements, which is what a connected bank account is for.
privacy.use3: To produce fiscal documents — Portuguese AT rent receipts — from data you have entered.
privacy.use4: To send the transactional email you have configured, such as rent reminders and lease-expiry alerts.
privacy.use5: To meet legal obligations under Portuguese law.
privacy.bankBody: Connecting a bank uses PSD2 account information access through Enable Banking, a licensed account information service provider. Access is read-only: this instance can read account details and transactions, and can never move money. You authorise the access at your own bank, not here, and the authorisation expires — 90 days unless your bank sets a shorter period — after which it must be granted again.
privacy.bankStorage: IBANs are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM. Matching and duplicate detection work from a one-way hash rather than the stored value, so the IBAN never needs to be decrypted to run the service. Only the last four digits are ever displayed. When you confirm a payment, the account it came from is remembered for that tenant: the same one-way hash, its last four digits and the payer's name as your bank showed it, so the next payment can be matched. You can forget it from the tenant at any time, and it is removed with the tenant.
privacy.bankRetention: A movement that has not been reconciled against a receipt is deleted after two years. A movement that has been reconciled is kept for as long as the receipt it evidences, because it is the record of where that money came from.
privacy.retentionIntro: The following are deleted automatically. Anything not listed is kept while your account exists and is removed when you delete it.
privacy.retentionAudit: Audit log: 7 years, to meet fiscal and legal record-keeping obligations.
privacy.retentionAccount: Deleting your account removes your data immediately and in full, including every bank connection, movement and document. It is not reversible and there is no grace period.
privacy.rights1: Access a copy of the personal data held about you. Account settings will produce a machine-readable export of all of it.
privacy.rights2: Correct anything inaccurate, directly in the app.
privacy.rights3: Have your data erased. Account settings will do this, immediately and completely.
privacy.rights4: Receive your data in a portable format — the same export satisfies this.
privacy.rights6: Complain to your national supervisory authority: the CNPD in Portugal, the AEPD in Spain.
privacy.rightsExportNote: The export deliberately omits the OAuth and session tokens stored against your account. Those are login credentials rather than information about you, and a downloadable file containing them would be a security risk to you.
privacy.cookiesBody: Only strictly necessary cookies: one for your session, one for CSRF protection. No advertising cookies, no third-party trackers, and no analytics that leave this instance.
privacy.processorsIntro: A self-hosted instance shares data with a service only when you have configured that service.
privacy.processorEnableBankingBody: Licensed account information service provider. Receives your bank authorisation and returns account and transaction data. Only where you connect a bank.
privacy.processorEmailBody: Delivers transactional email, and therefore sees the recipient address and the message. EU-based (France). Only where email is configured.
privacy.processorTaxBody: Receive the fiscal filings you choose to submit.
privacy.contactBody: For data protection enquiries, or to exercise any of the rights above, write to:

terms.acceptanceBody: By creating an account or using this Situs instance you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use it.
terms.serviceBody: Situs is property-management software for landlords and property managers in Portugal: properties, tenants, leases, receipts, expenses, maintenance and fiscal compliance. It is provided as is. It assists with fiscal obligations; it does not discharge them, and it is not a substitute for an accountant.
terms.accounts2: You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential.
terms.accounts3: Tell the operator promptly about any unauthorised access.
terms.accounts4: Accounts are personal and are not transferable without written consent.
terms.useIntro: You must not use Situs to:
terms.use1: Break any applicable law or regulation.
terms.use2: Store data you have no legal right to hold.
terms.use3: Reverse-engineer, disassemble or exploit the platform.
terms.use4: Send unsolicited messages through its email features.
terms.bankBody: Where you connect a bank account, you authorise read-only access at your own bank under PSD2. You are responsible for connecting only accounts you are entitled to access. The connection can be revoked at your bank or by removing it here, and it expires on its own; expiry stops the feed and nothing else.
terms.liabilityBody: To the extent the law permits, the operator is not liable for indirect or consequential loss, for lost profit, or for loss of data beyond the most recent backup. Nothing here limits liability that cannot lawfully be limited.
terms.ipBody: The software and its design remain the property of their authors. Your data remains yours; using Situs grants no rights over it beyond running the service for you.
terms.terminationBody: You may delete your account at any time, which erases your data immediately and completely. The operator may suspend an account that breaches these terms.
terms.lawBody: Portuguese law, with the courts of Lisbon having jurisdiction, unless mandatory consumer-protection rules in your own country say otherwise.
